tools.name: rufi.get_overview
tools.description: The active person's health record in Rufi at a glance: their name, how many documents and reports they have, their current results exactly as printed (id, test, value, category: lab or measurement, unit, reference range, flag, method or context, measured date at the precision known), their other records by kind (medicine uses, prescriptions, symptoms, conditions, allergies, care events, "none known" statements, follow-ups; each with its id and fields as save_changes takes them), their latest saves with what each changed, and record_version: a number every save raises, which create_brief takes. At most 20 results, newest measured first, undated last; at most 50 records of a kind, newest first; the latest 5 saves, newest first. An amended result replaces the one it corrects and says "amended": true. Removed records aren't shown. Takes no input: Rufi chooses the person, not you.

tools.name: rufi.get_records
tools.description: The active person's records of one kind (medicine_use, prescription, symptom, condition, allergy, result, care_event, none_known, follow_up), as stored: each with its id, its version (the save that last changed it; null when none did), its fields as save_changes takes them and its sources (the user's message, or a document's page), also the records removed from the record ("removed": true) and results replaced by an amended one ("replaced_by": the amended result's id). Newest first, undated last. For results, category reads only lab results or only measurements; without it, both. With from or to, only records dated in that period: medicine_use by started, prescription by issued, symptom by onset, condition by recognised, allergy by reacted, result by measured, care_event by date, none_known by asserted, follow_up by due. A record dated at a lower precision is read when its year or month overlaps the period ("2026" is in from 2026-03); a record with no date is read only without from and to. With ids, exactly those records. With report (kind result), only the results of that report: the id of a report the user added to their message. At most 200 records and 32 KB of records (as UTF-8 JSON) come back at once (a single larger record comes back on its own); when there are more, the answer says "complete": false and gives "next": pass it as after, with the same kind, category, from, to and report, to read on until "complete" is true. Read only: nothing changes. Count, compare and find trends in the records yourself. Rufi chooses the person, not you.

kind.description: The kind of record, as save_changes names it.

from.description: The earliest date to read, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; leave it out for no start.

to.description: The latest date to read, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; leave it out for no end.

category.description: Results only: just lab results or just measurements; leave it out for both.

ids.description: Exactly these records, by id (at most 200); not with from, to or after.

report.description: Only the results of this report, by its id (kind result only); not with ids.

after.description: The `next` of the previous answer, to read on with the same kind, category, from, to and report.

tools.name: rufi.get_documents
tools.description: The active person's documents (lab reports, prescriptions, letters they added), read only. Without document: the list, newest first, each with its id, when it was added, its files and pages, and its reading's status: "not_read" (never read; retry_reading reads it), "reading" (Rufi's reader is reading it now; its items come when it ends), "done" or "failed". With document: its version (it rises when a reading or a fix changes its draft items), its pages (each with what the reader found: its state, its facts such as dates, lab, report number and the name printed on it, and its issues) and its draft items: what the reader read, each with its id, version, page, status (not saved, saved with how and into which record, or dismissed), fields exactly as printed (a date on the item is its own; without one, the page's first printed date is used when it is saved), and why it may be unsure. Draft items are not saved: they are not the record and count in no answer until the user saves them. With document and page: that page as an image, with the page's own text when the PDF has some (use it for exact characters); a photo or a scan is the image alone. At most 50 documents, 100 pages or 100 draft items come back; when there are more, the answer has "next": pass it as after to read on. Rufi chooses the person, not you.

document.description: A document's id, from the list. Leave it out for the list.

page.description: A page of that document, 1, 2, 3...: you get the page's image and its own text when it has some.

after.description: The `next` of the previous answer, to read on.

tools.name: rufi.read_chat
tools.description: Earlier parts of this chat, newest first. Each entry's kind is "message" (the user's), "steer" (the user's, sent while you were replying), "reply" (yours), "activity" (one thing you did: a title and one short detail, never its output), "receipt" (Rufi's line for a save to the record: what was saved), "event" (Rufi's own line about something that happened, never the user's words) or "brief" (Rufi's line for a visit brief made with create_brief). "at" is when it was written. At most 50 entries a page; pass the page's next_before to read further back. Rufi chooses the chat, not you.

before.description: Read entries before this position: the `next_before` of the previous page.

limit.description: How many entries, 1 to 50; 20 when left out.

tools.name: rufi.save_changes
tools.description:
Saves to the active person's record, all or nothing, after the user clearly said yes to exactly this in this chat. Two parts, either or both:
- changes: typed changes from the user's own words. Each is one record: add one, change the fields given (the rest stay as they are), remove one (it stays in history), restore a removed one, or remove_source (take a document page off a record's sources, to undo "another source": the page goes in from, as {document, page} from the record's sources in get_records); ids come from get_overview or get_records. Give only what the user said: a field they didn't give stays out, and a date comes with the words it came from. A result's category (lab or measurement) is the one field you choose, with the user: every added result needs one, except an amended result, which keeps the category of the one it replaces unless you give one. A result read from a document changes in place only its category, in a change of its own; what it prints and its date change only by amendment. source is the user's message the change rests on: leave it out for their message in this turn (where they said yes); for an earlier message of theirs, give its position as read_chat shows it.
- items: draft items of the user's documents (get_documents), each with the version you read and how it goes in: new, another_source (the same result is already saved: its values stay, and the document page becomes another source) or correction (it corrects a saved result: a new result replaces it); record names the saved result, with its version from get_records. category: lab or measurement, for new; a correction keeps the corrected result's unless you give one; never for another_source. Rufi takes each item's values from the stored item, never from you, and its date from the item or, for a lab result, its page; a measurement is dated only by its own date or the user's; fix holds only a value the user corrected in the chat, or the date they gave for an item with none (a rough one is fine, at their precision), with the words it came from; its source is as a change's. An item already saved at that version returns its earlier save; a dismissed item, or one whose version changed, is refused, and nothing is saved.
No count limit. Rufi refuses a save with any problem and says each one; nothing is saved then. On success Rufi adds its own receipt to the chat and returns it; the same call again returns the same receipt. warnings name a date that should have happened by then (an onset, a measurement, done care) but is later than the message it rests on: it is saved as given; if it may be a slip, check with the user. Never say something was saved without this tool's answer.
Fields by kind, in changes[].fields (a date is {"date": "2026-09-28", "words": "last Monday"}: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in local time, at the precision the user gave, with the words it came from):
- medicine_use: name, strength, amount, schedule, route, purpose, status (current|paused|stopped|completed|unknown), started (date), ended (date)
- prescription: item, strength, amount, route, schedule, period, prescriber, issued (date)
- symptom: name, status (ongoing|resolved|unknown), onset (date), ended (date), severity, location, intermittent (true|false), details
- condition: name, certainty (suspected|diagnosed|unknown), status (ongoing|resolved|unknown), recognised (date), resolved (date), details
- allergy: substance, reaction, status (active|inactive|unknown), certainty (confirmed|suspected|unknown), reacted (date)
- result: test, value, category (lab|measurement), comparator (<|<=|>|>=), number, second_number, unit, range, flag, context, measured (date), replaces
- care_event: type (visit|procedure|immunisation), name, status (planned|done|not_done|unknown), date (date), provider, details
- none_known: category (allergies)
- follow_up: title, due (date or "next_visit"), status (open|done|dropped), outcome, about ({kind: medicine_use|prescription|symptom|condition|allergy|result|care_event, id} of another record)
A draft item's fix.fields: test, value, comparator (<|<=|>|>=), number, unit, range, flag, context, measured (date).

record.description: For another_source and correction: the saved result it is another source for, or corrects.

fix.description: Only when the user said a value of this item is different from what was read (a misread digit, the right date): the fields they gave. Never for another_source.

items.description: Draft items of the user's documents to save, as get_documents gave them.

date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the user's local time, at the precision they gave: 'since 2019' is 2019. Count relative words from when the user sent the message (read_chat shows it), not from now.

words.description: The words the date came from, as the user or the document said them: 'last Monday', 'since 2019', 'December'.

tools.name: rufi.dismiss_items
tools.description: Dismisses draft items of the user's documents that the user doesn't want saved (a test that isn't theirs, a row read by mistake), after you said which items you would set aside and the user clearly said yes to that in this chat ('it isn't mine' alone is not a yes): each is never saved later, and Rufi adds a receipt line to the chat. Give each item's version as you read it with get_documents; one that changed since is refused, and nothing is dismissed. An item already dismissed stays so; a saved item can't be dismissed (remove its record with save_changes instead). Only in a message from the user, never in a turn a Rufi event started.

item.description: The draft item's id, from get_documents.

version.description: The item's version as you read it.

tools.name: rufi.retry_reading
tools.description: Reads a document again where its reading failed, when the user asks you to: a reading that failed continues where it stopped; a finished reading reads only its pages that couldn't be read or weren't looked at, and never changes the draft items already read; a document never read is read in full. Only in a message from the user, never in a turn a Rufi event started. The reading runs in the background; its line comes in the chat when it ends.

tools.name: rufi.create_brief
tools.description: Saves a visit brief for the active person: a dated page Rufi shows with a Copy button, and a line in this chat that opens it. Before you read the record for the brief, take record_version from get_overview, and give it here unchanged. Write the brief from saved records only, and give in cited every record its facts come from (kind and id, at least one); Rufi lists them under the brief as its Sources. Name the facts in plain words in the brief: no ids, footnotes or citation marks. Rufi refuses a record that wasn't saved in this person's record at record_version, or was removed then; nothing is made then. The same call again returns the same brief. The brief never changes once made; for a changed record, make a new one.

markdown.description: The brief in Markdown: short sections, every fact from a record you cite, questions labelled as questions. No links or images.

record_version.description: The record_version get_overview gave you before you read the record for this brief.

kind.description: The record's kind, as get_records names it.

id.description: The record's id, from get_overview or get_records.

cited.description: Every saved record the brief's facts come from, at least one.

examples.markdown:
## For the visit on Friday 16 Oct

### Current medicines
- Metformin 500 mg, twice a day

### Recent results
- HbA1c 6.8 % (lab range 4.0 - 5.6, marked High), 12 Aug 2026

### Questions to ask
- Question: Is the HbA1c a reason to change the Metformin?
